claim_snippets.claim_text: If the classifier blocks an action three times in a row or twenty times total in one session, auto mode falls back to prompting for each action.
Subagent spawns are evaluated by the classifier, and subagent tool calls are independently classified under the same block and allow rules when auto mode is inherited.

In auto mode, the classifier receives user messages and tool calls plus CLAUDE.md, but Claude’s own text and tool results are stripped out so hostile file or web content cannot directly manipulate the classifier.
